capabilities: Highlight, underline, and annotate PDF text with editable notes
Draw freehand ink strokes with adjustable colors and widths
Search PDF text and restore saved reading positions
Export annotations to Markdown notes with backlinks to PDF pages
Translate or explain selected text via an OpenAI-compatible endpoint
extras: Desktop only, Obsidian 1.13.7+; macOS verified while Windows and Linux still need platform testing. API key is stored in plaintext in data.json. Annotations live in sibling *.annotations.json sidecars and exported notes in *.notes.md, both requiring manual backup; old paper-reader:// links are not migrated.
problem: Obsidian lacks built-in PDF annotation, freehand ink, and structured export of reading notes with links back to the source page.

relations.evidence: It bundles Mozilla PDF.js under Apache-2.0

summary: PDF paper reader with text highlights, ink drawing, full-text search, and append-only Markdown note export linking back to PDF pages; optional AI via your own endpoint.
